requirements.description: The user explicitly wants proximity to public transport. Value is the 75th percentile of mobility (70.93), rounded to 71.
A university student residence clearly needs nearby education facilities (schools and universities). Value is the 75th percentile of education (75.14), rounded to 75.
The user explicitly requires at least 850 sqm of gross floor area, which maps directly to the surface_area column.

User prefers energy class C or better, so classes A1 through C are included. The user did not mention consumption, so the energy_class column is used rather than epglnren_ape. Gross floor area (at least 850 sqm), capacity (60 people), and proximity to public transport are not available columns and are not filtered here.

output.sql: SELECT * FROM ESTATES WHERE property_type = 'Uffici e assimilabili' AND surface_area >= 850 AND haversine_km(latitude, longitude, 45.0677551, 7.6824892) <= 3.0 AND energy_class IN ('A1', 'A2', 'A3', 'A4', 'B', 'C') AND mobility >= 71 AND education >= 75 ORDER BY haversine_km(latitude, longitude, 45.0677551, 7.6824892) ASC
output.explanation: Filters the ESTATES table to office-type properties (property_type 'Uffici e assimilabili') with surface_area >= 850 sqm, within 3.0 km of the Turin coordinates (45.0677551, 7.6824892) via haversine distance on latitude/longitude, energy_class in A1–A4, B, C, mobility score >= 71 and education score >= 75. Results are ordered by distance from the coordinates. The 60-occupant capacity was not among the extracted requirements, so it is not filtered on.
